item.title: The Essential Dining Guide to White Rock Lake Restaurants in East Dallas
item.description: The heart of East Dallas is White Rock Lake, a sprawling 1,015-acre city escape. With more than nine miles of biking and hiking trails, the lake draws neighbors and visitors from across Dallas on weekdays and weekends alike.
